```{r}


land_mask <- st_transform(ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "land", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf"), 4326)
ocean_mask <- st_transform(ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "ocean", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf"), 4326)

out_dir <- "plots/patchwork_grids"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- OLDSPOT PATHS ---
path_cold_land <- "GHCN_terr/coldspots/ws_4326_final_coldspot2.tif"
path_cold_sea  <- "Argos/final_coldspot_raster_1res_4326.tif"
path_cold_air  <- "radio/rs_coldspot_res5_80presist_4326.tif" 

# --- SPECIES RICHNESS NORMALIZED PATHS ---
#path_srn_land <- "terrestrial_no_bats_species_richness_normalized_4326.tif"
path_srn_land <- "terrestrial_species_richness_normalized_4326touches.tif"
path_srn_sea  <- "marine_species_richness_normalized_4326touches.tif"
path_srn_air  <- "aerial_species_richness_normalized_4326touches.tif"


my_richness_colors <- c(
  "#91c789", 
  "#ffffbf",
  "#ffd490", 
  "#fdae61",
  "#c51b7d", 
  "#4d004b"  
)


base_theme <- function() {
  theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 10)),
      axis.title.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 16, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 15)),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "#3b3b3b", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.6, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5) 
    )
}

get_mask_config <- function(env) {
  #Custom linewidths
  if (env == "land") {
    return(list(top_sf = ocean_mask, top_fill = "lightgrey", top_color = "#3b3b3b", top_alpha = 1, top_linewidth = 0.05))
  } else if (env == "sea") {
    return(list(top_sf = land_mask, top_fill = "lightgrey", top_color = "#3b3b3b", top_alpha = 1, top_linewidth = 0.05))
  } else { 
    return(list(top_sf = land_mask, top_fill = NA, top_color = "#3b3b3b", top_alpha = 1, top_linewidth = 0.2))
  }
}

#  COLDSPOT PLOTTER
plot_grid_coldspot <- function(cold_path, env, col_title = NULL, row_title = NULL, show_legend = TRUE) {
  cold_df <- as.data.frame(rast(cold_path), xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  colnames(cold_df)[3] <- "value"
  cfg <- get_mask_config(env)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = land_mask, fill = "white", color = NA) +
    geom_tile(data = cold_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = factor(value))) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Coldspot", values = c("1" = "#288CBE"), na.translate = FALSE, labels = "") +
    geom_sf(data = cfg$top_sf, fill = cfg$top_fill, color = cfg$top_color, alpha = cfg$top_alpha, linewidth = cfg$top_linewidth) +
    coord_sf(ylim = c(-85, 85), expand = FALSE) + 
    labs(title = col_title, y = row_title) + 
    base_theme()
  
  if (!show_legend) p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  return(p)
}

#BIODIVERSITY PLOTTER
plot_grid_bio <- function(bio_path, env, row_title = NULL, leg_title = "Value", limits = NULL, show_legend = TRUE) {
  bio_df <- as.data.frame(rast(bio_path), xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  colnames(bio_df)[3] <- "value"
  cfg <- get_mask_config(env)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_tile(data = bio_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value)) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(name = leg_title, colors = my_richness_colors, limits = limits, na.value = NA) +
    geom_sf(data = cfg$top_sf, fill = cfg$top_fill, color = cfg$top_color, alpha = cfg$top_alpha, linewidth = cfg$top_linewidth) +
    coord_sf(ylim = c(-85, 85), expand = FALSE) + 
    labs(y = row_title) + 
    base_theme()
  
  if (!show_legend) p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  return(p)
}

# OVERLAP PLOTTER
plot_grid_overlap <- function(bio_path, cold_path, env, row_title = NULL, leg_title = "Value", limits = NULL, show_legend = TRUE) {
  cold_r <- rast(cold_path)
  bio_r <- resample(rast(bio_path), cold_r, method = "near")
  
  overlap_r <- bio_r * cold_r
  overlap_r[overlap_r == 0] <- NA 
  
  cold_df <- as.data.frame(cold_r, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  colnames(cold_df)[3] <- "value"
  ov_df <- as.data.frame(overlap_r, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  colnames(ov_df)[3] <- "value"
  
  min_val <- min(ov_df$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  custom_breaks <- unique(c(min_val, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00))
  
  cfg <- get_mask_config(env)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = land_mask, fill = "white", color = NA) +
    geom_tile(data = cold_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = factor(value))) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Coldspot with\nNo Overlap", 
      values = c("1" = "#288CBE"), 
      na.translate = FALSE, 
      labels = "", 
      guide = guide_legend(order = 1)
    ) +
    new_scale_fill() +
    geom_tile(data = ov_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value)) +
  
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      name = leg_title, 
      colors = my_richness_colors, 
      limits = c(0, 1),           
      breaks = custom_breaks,     
      labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x), 
      na.value = NA,
      guide = guide_colorbar(order = 2)
    ) +
    geom_sf(data = cfg$top_sf, fill = cfg$top_fill, color = cfg$top_color, alpha = cfg$top_alpha, linewidth = cfg$top_linewidth) +
    coord_sf(ylim = c(-85, 85), expand = FALSE) + 
    labs(y = row_title) + 
    base_theme()
  
  if (!show_legend) p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  return(p)
}



p_c_land <- plot_grid_coldspot(path_cold_land, "land", col_title = "LAND", row_title = "Global Gaps", show_legend = FALSE)
p_c_sea  <- plot_grid_coldspot(path_cold_sea,  "sea",  col_title = "OCEAN", show_legend = FALSE)
p_c_air  <- plot_grid_coldspot(path_cold_air,  "air",  col_title = "AIR", show_legend = TRUE)

l_sr <- "No. species"



# --- SPECIES RICHNESS NORMALIZED ---
l_srn <- "No. of species\n(normalized)"
p_srn_land <- plot_grid_bio(path_srn_land, "land", row_title = "Species Richness\nNormalized", leg_title = l_srn, limits = c(0,1), show_legend = FALSE)
p_srn_sea  <- plot_grid_bio(path_srn_sea,  "sea",  leg_title = l_srn, limits = c(0,1), show_legend = FALSE)
p_srn_air  <- plot_grid_bio(path_srn_air,  "air",  leg_title = l_srn, limits = c(0,1), show_legend = TRUE)

p_ov3_land <- plot_grid_overlap(path_srn_land, path_cold_land, "land", row_title = "Overlap", leg_title = l_srn, limits = c(0,1), show_legend = FALSE)
p_ov3_sea  <- plot_grid_overlap(path_srn_sea,  path_cold_sea,  "sea",  leg_title = l_srn, limits = c(0,1), show_legend = FALSE)
p_ov3_air  <- plot_grid_overlap(path_srn_air,  path_cold_air,  "air",  leg_title = l_srn, limits = c(0,1), show_legend = TRUE)

grid_opt3 <- (p_c_land | p_c_sea | p_c_air) / (p_srn_land | p_srn_sea | p_srn_air) / (p_ov3_land | p_ov3_sea | p_ov3_air)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Species_Richness_Normalized_all_1res_touches_1957.png"), grid_opt3, width = 16, height = 9, dpi = 500)
```

```{r}


land_mask <- ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "land", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")
ocean_mask <- ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "ocean", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")

out_dir <- "plots/patchwork_grids"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- COLDSPOT PATHS ---
path_cold_land <- "GHCN_terr/coldspots/ws_4326_final_coldspot2.tif"
path_cold_sea  <- "Argos/final_coldspot_raster_1res_4326.tif"
path_cold_air  <- "radio/rs_coldspot_res5_80presist_4326.tif" 

# --- TOP FAMILY OVERLAP RASTER PATHS ---
# Land: Bovidae & Felidae
path_land_1 <- "GHCN_terr/GHCN_overlap/esri_4326/Bovidae_terrestrial_GHCN_overlap_48.tif"
path_land_2 <- "GHCN_terr/GHCN_overlap/esri_4326/Felidae_terrestrial_GHCN_overlap_22.tif"

# Sea: Laridae & Procellariidae
path_sea_1  <- "Argos/argo_overlap/esri_4326/Laridae_marine_argo_overlap_60.tif"
path_sea_2  <- "Argos/argo_overlap/esri_4326/Procellariidae_marine_argo_overlap_78.tif"

# Air: Laridae & Accipitridae
path_air_1  <- "radio/esri_4326/Laridae_aerial_radiooverlap_72.tif"
path_air_2  <- "radio/esri_4326/Accipitridae_aerial_radiooverlap_92.tif"

#  PHYLOPIC FETCHER

get_phylopic_img <- function(family_name) {
  uuid_dict <- list(
    "Accipitridae"    = "a92be6af-cb30-4d55-a3b0-cc3016be6c6c",
    "Anatidae"        = "97f833ff-fcd8-4113-8948-721c75372462",
    "Balaenopteridae" = "fd8d3e5e-24a0-4aa2-9211-987ff86007dd",
    "Bovidae"         = "dbf2f035-6c04-4c4f-a9aa-f01a1e35ea9c",
    "Canidae"         = "4b31c74e-7fbb-4ec9-a96e-f5b281c2b9d4",
    "Carcharhinidae"  = "49039ecb-e03b-4cdc-9c9a-0393bf0ffe99",
    "Cervidae"        = "4b474bdd-24e0-428d-b1f0-6d221ffc6367",
    "Charadriidae"    = "fcc3ea71-17d5-44cc-8b52-dea48a83c943",
    "Delphinidae"     = "388e792c-f8fd-4bd8-ad38-e251b5244ac0",
    "Equidae"         = "f7d817d0-d733-493d-bd4a-3f178e0760a8",
    "Felidae"         = "3f8eff77-2868-4121-8d7d-a55ebdd49e04",
    "Hydrobatidae"    = "d6668ea1-5914-4b05-abe9-fbc7562f83fc",
    "Labridae"        = "b25eec2b-7397-49ea-a42b-4ffe6250870b",
    "Laridae"         = "23eecd7f-89e1-45c5-9d8a-7c7f373d3af7",
    "Mustelidae"      = "5e13bb38-4c9f-4c7a-9c5c-0597fd33e4ab",
    "Phocidae"        = "10d73995-c697-405e-8ffd-fc9900d3a3cb",
    "Procellariidae"  = "a8ecc1e9-f339-4d85-84c3-aa2fff47b2c1",
    "Scolopacidae"    = "145b43ea-a9d7-4a98-8764-2ebefd6cefe8",
    "Stercorariidae"  = "bc1b9b9b-0f3e-41b4-b342-cf669b69afa1",
    "Oceanitidae"     = "Oceanites oceanicus"
  )
  
  if (family_name %in% names(uuid_dict)) {
    uuid <- uuid_dict[[family_name]]
  } else {
    uuid <- tryCatch({ get_uuid(name = family_name, n = 1) }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
  }
  
  if (is.null(uuid) || is.na(uuid)) return(NULL)
  
  img <- tryCatch({ get_phylopic(uuid = uuid) }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
  return(img)
}


plot_family_overlap <- function(overlap_path, coldspot_path, env, analysis_label, height_option, col_header = NULL) {
  
  coldspots <- rast(coldspot_path)
  ov_raster <- rast(overlap_path)

  
  if (env == "land") {
    mask_sf <- st_transform(ocean_mask, crs(coldspots))
    mask_fill <- "lightgrey"; mask_color <- "#3b3b3b"; lw <- .05
  } else if (env == "sea") {
    mask_sf <- st_transform(land_mask, crs(coldspots))
    mask_fill <- "lightgrey"; mask_color <- "#3b3b3b" ; lw <- .05
  } else {
    mask_sf <- st_transform(land_mask, crs(coldspots))
    mask_fill <- NA; mask_color <- "#3b3b3b"; lw <- .2
  }
  
  coldspots_aligned <- resample(coldspots, ov_raster, method = "near")
  coldspots_df <- as.data.frame(coldspots_aligned, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  colnames(coldspots_df)[3] <- "value"
  
  sps_df <- as.data.frame(ov_raster, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  colnames(sps_df)[3] <- "value"
  
  base_title <- sub("\\.tif$", "", basename(overlap_path))
  parts <- str_split(base_title, "_")[[1]]
  family_name <- str_to_title(parts[1])
  n_species <- parse_number(base_title)
  n_species_char <- paste0("(n=", n_species, ")")
  plot_title <- paste0(family_name, " ", n_species_char)
  
  plot_xlim <- c(-180, 180)
  plot_ylim <- c(-85, 85)
  x_span <- diff(plot_xlim)
  y_span <- diff(plot_ylim)
  
  icon_xpos <- plot_xlim[2] - 0.08 * x_span
  ypos      <- plot_ylim[1] + 0.16 * y_span
  text_y    <- ypos - 0.09 * y_span
  
  phylo_img <- get_phylopic_img(family_name)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = land_mask, fill = "white", color = NA) +
    
    geom_tile(data = coldspots_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = factor(value))) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Coldspot with\nNo Overlap", values = c("1" = "#288CBE"), 
                      na.translate = FALSE, labels = "", guide = guide_legend(order = 1)) +
    
    new_scale_fill() +
    
    geom_tile(data = sps_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value)) +
    scale_fill_distiller(name = "No. of species\n(normalized)", palette = "YlOrRd", 
                         direction = 1, limits = c(0, 1), guide = guide_colorbar(order = 2)) +
    
    geom_sf(data = mask_sf, fill = mask_fill, color = mask_color, linewidth = lw ) +
    coord_sf(xlim = plot_xlim, ylim = plot_ylim, expand = FALSE) +
    -
    labs(title = col_header, subtitle = plot_title) +
    

 theme_void() +
    theme(

      panel.border = element_rect(color = "#3b3b3b", fill = NA, linewidth = .4),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      
      # Formatting the headers
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      

      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),
      

      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key.height = unit(1.0, "cm"),  
      legend.key.width = unit(.75, "cm"),  
      legend.margin = margin(l = 10)         
    )
  
  if (!is.null(phylo_img)) {
    p <- p +
      add_phylopic(img = phylo_img, x = icon_xpos, y = ypos, height = height_option * y_span, alpha = 1, color = "black") +
      annotate("text", x = icon_xpos, y = text_y, label = n_species_char, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3)
  } else {
    p <- p +
      annotate("text", x = icon_xpos, y = ypos, label = n_species_char, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 4)
  }
  
  return(p)
}


# Row 1: Top family per environment
p_land_1 <- plot_family_overlap(path_land_1, path_cold_land, "land", "Terrestrial", .12, col_header = "LAND")
p_sea_1  <- plot_family_overlap(path_sea_1,  path_cold_sea,  "sea",  "Marine", .1, col_header = "OCEAN")
p_air_1  <- plot_family_overlap(path_air_1,  path_cold_air,  "air",  "Aerial", .12, col_header = "AIR")

# Row 2: Second family per environment
p_land_2 <- plot_family_overlap(path_land_2, path_cold_land, "land", "Terrestrial", .08)
p_sea_2  <- plot_family_overlap(path_sea_2,  path_cold_sea,  "sea",  "Marine", .12)
p_air_2  <- plot_family_overlap(path_air_2,  path_cold_air,  "air",  "Aerial", .12)


top_families_grid <- (p_land_1 | p_sea_1 | p_air_1) / 
                     (p_land_2 | p_sea_2 | p_air_2) +
                     plot_layout(guides = "collect") 
print(top_families_grid)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "TopFamilies_Overlap_Grid_touchesv2.png"),
  plot = top_families_grid,
  width = 16, height = 8, dpi = 500
)
```

```{r}
# GET TOP 5

get_top_5 <- function(data, env, metric_col, value_name, family_name) {
  data %>%
    filter(Environment == env) %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[metric_col]])) %>%
    slice_head(n = 5) %>%
    mutate(Rank = row_number()) %>%
   
    select(Environment, Rank, !!family_name := family, !!value_name := all_of(metric_col))
}


#  EXTRACT TOP 5 BY RICHNESS & OVERLAP

# Top 5 by Most Species
richness_top5 <- bind_rows(
  get_top_5(df_all, "Land", "num_species", "Species_Count", "Family_Most_Species"),
  get_top_5(df_all, "Sea",  "num_species", "Species_Count", "Family_Most_Species"),
  get_top_5(df_all, "Air",  "num_species", "Species_Count", "Family_Most_Species")
)

# Top 5 by Largest Overlap
overlap_top5 <- bind_rows(
  get_top_5(df_all, "Land", "overlap_area_km2", "Overlap_Area_km2", "Family_Largest_Overlap"),
  get_top_5(df_all, "Sea",  "overlap_area_km2", "Overlap_Area_km2", "Family_Largest_Overlap"),
  get_top_5(df_all, "Air",  "overlap_area_km2", "Overlap_Area_km2", "Family_Largest_Overlap")
)


# Join the two tables together by Environment and Rank
publication_table <- richness_top5 %>%
  inner_join(overlap_top5, by = c("Environment", "Rank")) %>%
  arrange(Environment, Rank)


print(publication_table)


write_csv(publication_table, "Top5_Families_Pub_Table_bats_touches_1957.csv")
```

```{r}
# Common theme for the top row to keep everything aligned
line_theme <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8, color = "grey30", face = "italic"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}

    x = "Year",

    tag = "Annual Sampling\nGaps" 
  ) +
  line_theme() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", 
    plot.tag.position = "left",
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 1, margin = margin(r = 15)),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 25) 
  )

#  ROW 2: PERSISTENCE MAPS 

get_mask_config <- function(env) {
  if (env == "land") return(list(top_sf = ocean_mask, fill = "lightgrey", color = NA))
  if (env == "sea")  return(list(top_sf = land_mask, fill = "lightgrey", color = NA))
  return(list(top_sf = land_mask, fill = NA, color = "#3b3b3b")) # Air
}

plot_persistence <- function(raster_path, env, row_title = NULL, show_legend = TRUE, color_scheme = "custom") {
  r_df <- as.data.frame(rast(raster_path), xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  colnames(r_df)[3] <- "value"
  cfg <- get_mask_config(env)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = land_mask, fill = "white", color = NA) +
    geom_tile(data = r_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value))
    
  # Toggle for color palette
  if (color_scheme == "RdYlBu") {
    p <- p + scale_fill_distiller(
      name = "Persistence", 
      palette = "RdYlBu", 
      direction = 1, 
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
      labels = scales::percent,
      na.value = NA
    )
  } else if (color_scheme == "coldspot_hybrid") {
    #  RdYlBu for 0-80%, coldspot blue for 80-100%
  coldspot_hybrid_colors <- c(
      "#d73027",  # 0% - Bright red (RdYlBu)
      "#fc8d59",  # 20% - Orange (RdYlBu)
      "#fee090",  # 40% - Light yellow (RdYlBu)
      "#ffffbf",  # 60% - Pale yellow (RdYlBu)
      "#e0f3f8",  # 70% - Very light blue (RdYlBu)
      "#288CBE",  # 80% - Coldspot blue 
      "#288CBE"   # 100% - Coldspot blue 
    )
    
    
    p <- p + scale_fill_gradientn(
      name = "Persistence", 
      colors = coldspot_hybrid_colors,
      values = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 1),  
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
      labels = scales::percent,
      na.value = NA
    )
  } else {
    p <- p + scale_fill_gradientn(
      name = "Persistence", 
      colors = my_richness_colors, 
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
      labels = scales::percent,
      na.value = NA
    )
  }
    
  p <- p + 
    geom_sf(data = cfg$top_sf, fill = cfg$fill, color = cfg$color, linewidth = 0.2) +
    coord_sf(ylim = c(-85, 85), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, tag = row_title) + 
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "#3b3b3b", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  
  if (!is.null(row_title)) {
    p <- p + theme(
      plot.tag.position = "left",
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 1, margin = margin(r = 15)),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 25) 
    )
  }

  if (!show_legend) {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
  
  return(p)
}
save_persistence_grid <- function(scheme, filename) {
  
  p_map_land <- plot_persistence("GHCN_terr/coldspots/ws_4326_gap_persist2.tif", "land", row_title = "Gap Persistence", show_legend = FALSE, color_scheme = scheme)
  p_map_sea  <- plot_persistence("Argos/gap_persist_1res_4326.tif", "sea", row_title = NULL, show_legend = FALSE, color_scheme = scheme)
  p_map_air  <- plot_persistence("radio/rs_gap_persist_res5_4326.tif", "air", row_title = NULL, show_legend = TRUE, color_scheme = scheme)

  final_grid <- (p_line_land | p_line_sea | p_line_air) /
                (p_map_land | p_map_sea | p_map_air) +
                plot_layout(guides = "collect")

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, filename),
    plot = final_grid,
    width = 16, height = 8, dpi = 500
  )
  print(paste("Saved:", filename))
}


save_persistence_grid("coldspot_hybrid", "Figure_Gap_Persistence_Grid_ColdspotHybrid.png")
```

```{r}
# PREP TRACKING DATA

prep_daily <- function(raw_df) {
  raw_df %>%
    clean_names() %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(timestamp)) %>%
    group_by(id = individual_local_identifier, date) %>%
    summarise(
      lon = median(location_long, na.rm = TRUE),
      lat = median(location_lat, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_fixes = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat))
}

make_track_lines_sf <- function(daily_df) {
  daily_df %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    filter(n() >= 2) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    map_dfr(function(d) {
      d <- d %>% arrange(date)
      st_sf(
        id = as.character(d$id[1]),
        start_date = min(d$date, na.rm = TRUE),
        end_date   = max(d$date, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_points   = nrow(d),
        geometry   = st_sfc(st_linestring(as.matrix(d[, c("lon", "lat")])), crs = 4326)
      )
    })
}

plot_animal_tracks <- function(tracks_sf, title, coldspot_path = NULL, x_buffer = 3, y_buffer = 3, include_states = FALSE) {
  
  bbox <- st_bbox(tracks_sf)
  xlim <- c(bbox["xmin"] - x_buffer, bbox["xmax"] + x_buffer)
  ylim <- c(bbox["ymin"] - y_buffer, bbox["ymax"] + y_buffer)
  
  num_ids <- length(unique(tracks_sf$id))
  track_colors <- colorRampPalette(high_contrast_palette)(num_ids)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = world, fill = "#f1f1f1", color = NA)
  
  if (!is.null(coldspot_path)) {
    cold_r <- rast(coldspot_path)
    crop_ext <- ext(xlim[1], xlim[2], ylim[1], ylim[2])
    cold_r_cropped <- crop(cold_r, crop_ext)
    
    cold_df <- as.data.frame(cold_r_cropped, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
    colnames(cold_df)[3] <- "value"
    
    p <- p + 
      geom_tile(data = cold_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = factor(value)), alpha = 0.65) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("1" = "#288CBE"), guide = "none")
  }
  
  p <- p + geom_sf(data = world, fill = NA, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.1)
  
  if (include_states) {
    p <- p + geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.1)
  }
  
  p <- p +
    geom_sf(data = tracks_sf, aes(colour = id), linewidth = 0.35, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = track_colors, guide = "none") +
    coord_sf(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, expand = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    ) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL)
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
my_richness_colors <- c(

norm_direct <- "normalized/esri_4326_touches"
norm_list <- list.files(norm_direct, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

for (norm_path in norm_list) {
  
  base_title <- sub("\\.tif$", "", basename(norm_path))
  
  
  clean_base <- sub("_4326touches$|_molltouches$|_4326$|_moll$", "", base_title)
  print(clean_base)
  

  if (grepl("normalized_mean", clean_base)) {
    metric_title <- "Family Richness"
    legend_title <- "No. of species\n(normalized by family)"
    analysis_part <- sub("_normalized_mean.*", "", clean_base)
    
  } else if (grepl("species_richness_normalized", clean_base)) {
    metric_title <- "Species Richness Normalized"
    legend_title <- "No. of species\n(normalized)"
    analysis_part <- sub("_species_richness_normalized.*", "", clean_base)
    
  } else if (grepl("family_richness", clean_base)) {
    metric_title <- "Family Richness"
    legend_title <- "No. of families"
    analysis_part <- sub("_family_richness.*", "", clean_base)
    
  } else {
    metric_title <- "Species Richness"
    legend_title <- "No. of species"
    analysis_part <- sub("_species_richness.*", "", clean_base)
  }


  analysis_title <- str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", analysis_part))
  
  # Build the final Plot Title (norm_title)
  if (grepl("Supp No Amphib", analysis_title)) {

    analysis_title <- gsub(" Supp No Amphib", "", analysis_title)
    # Add ychosen suffix
    norm_title <- paste(analysis_title, metric_title, "(with exclusions)")
    
  } else if (grepl("No Bats", analysis_title)) {
    # Clean up "No Bats" to have parentheses
    analysis_title <- gsub(" No Bats", " (No Bats)", analysis_title)
    norm_title <- paste(analysis_title, metric_title)
    
  } else {
    # Standard groups (Marine, Terrestrial, Freshwater, etc)
    norm_title <- paste(analysis_title, metric_title)
  }
  
  # Load raster
  norm_r <- rast(norm_path)
  
  # Transform masks to match raster CRS
  ocean_mask_crs <- st_transform(ocean_mask, crs(norm_r))
  land_mask_crs  <- st_transform(land_mask,  crs(norm_r))
  

  # Set default flags
  draw_ocean_bg <- FALSE
  draw_land_mask_top <- FALSE
  draw_land_outline_top <- FALSE
  
  if (str_detect(tolower(norm_title), "marine")) {
    # Marine maps get a solid gray land mask on top to hide coastal spill
    draw_land_mask_top <- TRUE
    
  } else {
    # Terrestrial (all versions), Freshwater, and Aerial

    draw_ocean_bg <- TRUE
 
    draw_land_outline_top <- TRUE
  }


  plot <- ggplot() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8)
    )

  if (draw_ocean_bg) {
    plot <- plot +
      geom_sf(data = ocean_mask_crs, fill = "#d5d5d5", color = NA) # Clean light gray
  }


  plot <- plot +
    geom_spatraster(data = norm_r) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(name = legend_title, colors = my_richness_colors, na.value = NA) +
    labs(title = norm_title)

  if (draw_land_mask_top) {
    # Solid gray land for Marine maps
    plot <- plot +
      geom_sf(data = land_mask_crs, fill = "#d5d5d5", color = "gray", size = 0.2)
  }
  
  if (draw_land_outline_top) {
    # Crisp outline for Terrestrial / Aerial / Freshwater
    plot <- plot +
      geom_sf(data = land_mask_crs, fill = NA, color = "#3b3b3b", size = 0.1, alpha = 0.4) 
  }


  plot <- plot + coord_sf(expand = FALSE)
  
  print(plot)
  
  out_direct <- paste0("plots/normalized/", base_title, "_colors4.png")
  
 
   ggsave(filename = out_direct, plot, width = 5, height = 3, dpi = 500)
}
```

```{r}
library(rphylopic)

get_phylopic_img <- function(family_name) {
  # Dictionary mapping families to the EXACT UUIDs from the URLs provided
  uuid_dict <- list(
    "Accipitridae"    = "a92be6af-cb30-4d55-a3b0-cc3016be6c6c",
    "Anatidae"        = "97f833ff-fcd8-4113-8948-721c75372462",

    "Bovidae"         = "dbf2f035-6c04-4c4f-a9aa-f01a1e35ea9c",
    "Canidae"         = "4b31c74e-7fbb-4ec9-a96e-f5b281c2b9d4",
    "Carcharhinidae"  = "49039ecb-e03b-4cdc-9c9a-0393bf0ffe99",
    "Cervidae"        = "4b474bdd-24e0-428d-b1f0-6d221ffc6367",
    "Charadriidae"    = "fcc3ea71-17d5-44cc-8b52-dea48a83c943",
    "Delphinidae"     = "388e792c-f8fd-4bd8-ad38-e251b5244ac0",
    "Equidae"         = "f7d817d0-d733-493d-bd4a-3f178e0760a8",
    "Felidae"         = "3f8eff77-2868-4121-8d7d-a55ebdd49e04",
    "Hydrobatidae"    = "d6668ea1-5914-4b05-abe9-fbc7562f83fc",
    "Labridae"        = "b25eec2b-7397-49ea-a42b-4ffe6250870b",
    "Laridae"         = "23eecd7f-89e1-45c5-9d8a-7c7f373d3af7",
    "Mustelidae"      = "5e13bb38-4c9f-4c7a-9c5c-0597fd33e4ab",
    "Phocidae"        = "10d73995-c697-405e-8ffd-fc9900d3a3cb",
    "Procellariidae"  = "a8ecc1e9-f339-4d85-84c3-aa2fff47b2c1",
    "Scolopacidae"    = "145b43ea-a9d7-4a98-8764-2ebefd6cefe8",
    "Stercorariidae"  = "bc1b9b9b-0f3e-41b4-b342-cf669b69afa1"
  )
  
  # 1. Try to get the exact UUID from our list
  if (family_name %in% names(uuid_dict)) {
    uuid <- uuid_dict[[family_name]]
  } else {
    # 2. Fallback: If it's a family not on the list (like Oceanitidae), search by name
    search_name <- ifelse(family_name == "Oceanitidae", "Oceanites oceanicus", family_name)
    uuid <- tryCatch({ get_uuid(name = search_name, n = 1) }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
  }
  
  if (is.null(uuid) || is.na(uuid)) return(NULL)
  
  # Download the specific image
  img <- tryCatch({ get_phylopic(uuid = uuid) }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
  return(img)
}
# ==============================================================================
# 2. MASTER PLOTTING FUNCTION
# ==============================================================================
generate_all_top_plots <- function(out_folder) {
  dir.create(out_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  # Define the configuration for all 3 realms
  configs <- list(
    list(
      domain = "Land",
      ov_dir = "GHCN_overlap/esri_4326_touches",
      cold_path = "ws_4326_final_coldspot2.tif",
      mask_sf = ocean_mask, mask_fill = "lightgrey", mask_col = "#3b3b3b", lw = 0.05,
      xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-85, 85)
    ),
    list(
      domain = "Ocean",
      ov_dir = "argo_overlap/esri_4326",
      cold_path = "final_coldspot_raster_1res_4326.tif",
      mask_sf = land_mask, mask_fill = "lightgrey", mask_col = "#3b3b3b", lw = 0.05,
      xlim = c(-176, 176), ylim = c(-85, 85)
    ),
    list(
      domain = "Air",
      ov_dir = "esri_4326",
      cold_path = "/rs_coldspot_res5_80presist_4326.tif",
      mask_sf = land_mask, mask_fill = NA, mask_col = "#696969", lw = 0.2,
      xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-85, 85)
    )
  )
  
  # Loop through Land, Sea, and Air
  for (cfg in configs) {
    cat("\n=== Processing Domain:", cfg$domain, "===\n")
    
    # Load coldspot"#7F7F7F
    coldspots <- rast(cfg$cold_path)
    mask_proj <- st_transform(cfg$mask_sf, crs(coldspots))
    
    # Get files
    all_files <- list.files(cfg$ov_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(all_files) == 0) { message("No files found in ", cfg$ov_dir); next }
    
    # Standardize icon position calculations
    x_span <- diff(cfg$xlim)
    y_span <- diff(cfg$ylim)
    icon_xpos <- cfg$xlim[2] - 0.08 * x_span  
    ypos      <- cfg$ylim[1] + 0.16 * y_span 
    text_y    <- ypos - 0.09 * y_span
    
    for (ov_file in all_files) {
      base_title <- sub("\\.tif$", "", basename(ov_file))
      family_name <- str_to_title(str_split(base_title, "_")[[1]][1])
      
     
      if (!(family_name %in% target_families)) next
      
      message("  Plotting: ", family_name)
      
      ov_raster <- rast(ov_file)
      ov_raster[ov_raster == 0] <- NA
      
      # Align coldspot specifically to this raster
      cold_aligned <- resample(coldspots, ov_raster, method = "near")
      cold_df <- as.data.frame(cold_aligned, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
      colnames(cold_df)[3] <- "value"
      
      n_species <- parse_number(base_title)
      n_species_char <- paste0("(n=", n_species, ")")
      plot_title <- paste0("**", cfg$domain, "** ", family_name, " ", n_species_char)
      
      sps_df <- as.data.frame(ov_raster, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
      colnames(sps_df)[3] <- "value"
      
      phylo_img <- get_phylopic_img(family_name)
      
      p <- ggplot() +
        geom_tile(data = cold_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = factor(value))) +
        scale_fill_manual(name = "Coldspot with\nNo Overlap", values = c("1" = "#288CBE"), 
                          na.value = NA, labels = "", na.translate = FALSE, guide = guide_legend(order = 1)) +
        new_scale_fill() +
        geom_tile(data = sps_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value)) +
        scale_fill_distiller(name = "No. of species\n(normalized)", palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1, limits=c(0,1), guide = guide_colorbar(order = 2)) +
        geom_sf(data = mask_proj, fill = cfg$mask_fill, color = cfg$mask_col, linewidth = cfg$lw) +
        coord_sf(xlim = cfg$xlim, ylim = cfg$ylim, expand = FALSE) +
        labs(title = plot_title) +
        theme(
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = .2),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
          plot.title = element_markdown(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.key = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(5, 15, 5, 5)
        )
      
      if (!is.null(phylo_img)) {
        p <- p +
          add_phylopic(img = phylo_img, x = icon_xpos, y = ypos, height = 0.12 * y_span, alpha = 1, color = "black") +
          annotate("text", x = icon_xpos, y = text_y, label = n_species_char, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3) 
      } else {
        p <- p +
          annotate("text", x = icon_xpos, y = ypos, label = n_species_char, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 4)
      }
      
      
      ggsave(file.path(out_folder, paste0(base_title, "_FinalPlot_1957.png")), p, width = 6, height = 3, dpi = 500)
    }
  }

}


output_folder <- "plots/Target_Family_Overlaps"

generate_all_top_plots(output_folder)
```
